name: rfsim
description: OAI RFsim gNB (51 PRB, band 78) + Virtual UEs on Kubernetes

traffic._calibration: 2026-10-05 (aura3): RFsim is not locked to wall time (2.5-2.9x real time on the lab host, ~10 %/s, per-minute means 2.1-3.1x), so a fixed input rate gives a drifting load (70M -> 74 % +/- 7, on 2026-10-02 70M -> 88 %). Measured on the gNB PRB ground truth: >= 100M saturates the cell at 93.2 % (sd 0.0) at any sim speed; 150M = 1.5x that point. Congestion is defined and verified on measured cell load (label.threshold_pct), the rate is only the stimulus; runs log rate, budget and sim speed (result.ground_truth).

model._note_reuse: on_train_failure: fail | reuse_last — on a rejected/failed training, deploy the newest stored model that passed both gates (step status 'reused', result.model_source='reused'). reuse_last: true skips training. Per run: overrides {"model": {...}}.

intent._note: parser: rule | llm. LLM = Docker Ollama on the GPU server (<home>/Ollama, GPU1, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1). Same OpenAI-compatible client as the AI chat; env DUAL_BRAIN_INTENT_PARSER / DUAL_BRAIN_LLM_URL / DUAL_BRAIN_LLM_MODEL override. fallback_to_rule: an LLM failure falls back to the rule parser, labeled 'rule'.

ground_truth._note: 51 PRB x (2 DL + 1 mixed slot per 2.5 ms TDD period) x 400 periods/s; sim speed = budget / this

demo._note: stop the congestion xApp after verify (releases the reservation); demo ops: scripts/dual_brain_demo.py
